_note_jsonMode: `sendJsonMode` is PER PROVIDER and defaults to true. It is set false for DeepSeek because its JSON mode returns 11-16 spaces with finish_reason 'stop' and HTTP 200 as a conversation grows, so that provider is asked in plain mode and its replies are parsed out of prose. Measurements and every explanation that was falsified are in NOTES-deepseek-json-mode.md. Gemini's JSON mode was checked on the same conversation and is fine, so it keeps it.
